definitions.explanation: Walking very quietly so as not to be noticed or heard. Often used with the particle で to describe the manner of walking.

examples.english: I left the room on tiptoe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こさない→起こす：01234_okosu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{忍|しの}び{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I walked stealthily so as not to wake the baby.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{忍|しの}び{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{獲物|えもの}→獲物：08638_emono⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づいて→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧いく⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧⟦{忍者|にんじゃ}→忍者：11112_ninja⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ようだ。
examples.english: The way the cat creeps toward its prey on stealthy feet is just like a ninja.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used with で as an adverbial phrase: {忍|しの}び{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk stealthily), {忍|しの}び{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧ (to approach stealthily).
Evokes a vivid image of quiet, careful movement. Often used in narrative and descriptive writing. Can apply to both humans and animals.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {忍|しの}び{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧ (to walk on tiptoe)
- {忍|しの}び{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧ (to sneak up on)
- {忍|しの}び{足|あし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧ (to sneak out)
